items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 53:1
items.html: This name is explained in the secret of the three verses in the portion of the Splitting of the Red Sea, which are: “and he journeyed,” “and he came,” “and he stretched out.” These contain 216 letters, and in the secret of the Hassadim of the upper Aba ve Ima they join in the secret of the 72 bridges of the waters of Hesed, for every three letters among them join into one word and one name. For these Hassadim of the GAR of Bina are called bridges, because the restriction and the bottom Hey do not rule over them, as is known, in the secret of “for He delights in mercy,” and you already know that the upper Aba ve Ima divide into sixty
